name: favourite-off-site-link-opens-a-peek
description: A target=_blank link to another host, clicked in a favourite's tab, opens the peek card instead of a new tab. The favourite is stored with a redirecting URL, the way a sibling scenario's is, so the tab it claims no longer carries the stored URL when the link is clicked: a fix keyed on the URL alone would open a tab here. The target is a different HOST, not a port, because auto-peek keeps same-site links in place on purpose.

actions.note: first paint, and the sidebar announces itself
the only favourite tile, at a sibling scenario's coordinates. This click OPENS and CLAIMS the tab.
VACUITY GUARD: no claim, nothing below is about a favourite's tab
the meta refresh moved the tab off the stored URL
the favourite's page, no card yet
THE MEASUREMENT: the off-site target=_blank link. The page sits right of the 280px sidebar with 40px padding, and the link is the block under the heading, at y 285 on the 2026-09-09 frames.

assertions.desc: the browser window AND the card, the way peek-auto-pinned counts them
VACUITY GUARD: the claimed tab left the stored URL before the click

assertions.label: peek-opened-from-a-favourites-tab
assertions.pattern: Atrium: peek widget showing for parent
assertions.desc: THE ASSERTION: the link opened the card

assertions.label: no-tab-took-the-link
assertions.desc: neither the favourite's tab nor a new one navigated to the target; a peek's page is not a strip tab and never logs this line
